item.title: Startup Mistake #2: Trying to Build the Perfect Product
item.description: Waiting for perfection is a silent startup killer because the market rewards learning speed far more than flawless code. By launching a lean MVP early, you trade expensive assumptions for real-world user data, ensuring you build what customers actually need instead of what you think they want. Remember: the goal isn’t to be right the first time, but to be "less wrong" as fast as humanly possible.
